abilities.name: Cryo-Freeze
abilities.description: Become encased in ice for 3 seconds, gaining a rapidly decaying Shield that absorbs up to 1104 damage. While active, this Shield grants Unstoppable and restores up to 35% of Mei's maximum Health.; 40 / 0.5

fields.notes: Cryo-Freeze can be reactivated after 0.5 seconds to end its effect early, removing the Shield, healing and Unstoppable. The Ability ends immediately if the Shield expires or breaks, removing Unstoppable status and healing.

abilities.name: Snow Blind
abilities.description: Throw a snowball that hits all enemies in an area. Enemies hit take 70 damage, are Slowed by 35%, and are Blinded for 1.75 seconds.

fields.notes: Slow and Blind are applied after the damage is dealt.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: Command Snowball to create a blizzard at the target location for 2 seconds. Enemies within the blizzard take 13 damage every 0.25 seconds and are Slowed by 7%, stacking up to 35%. When the blizzard ends, enemies within its area take an additional 75 damage and are Stunned for 1.25 seconds.

fields.notes: Slow is applied before the periodic damage is dealt. Each instance of ramping up the Slow counts as applying it. Final damage is dealt in a separate instance on the last tick in addition to the periodic damage. Stun is applied after the final damage is dealt.

abilities.name: Icing
abilities.description: Slide quickly in the targeted direction. When this effect ends, enemies near Mei are knocked back, take 52 damage, and are Slowed by 80%, rapidly decaying over 1.5 seconds.; 14 / 0.25

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control / Movement: Dash
fields.notes: Icing can be reactivated after 0.25 seconds to stop the dash and trigger its end effect early. Knockback is applied before the damage is dealt. Slow is applied as the knockback effect expires.

abilities.name: Avalanche
abilities.description: After 0.5 seconds, roll a massive snowball that consumes enemy Heroes in its path. At the end of its path, the snowball crumbles, releasing the consumed Heroes, dealing 220 damage and Stunning them for 0.5 per Hero consumed.

fields.type: Spell Damage, Crowd control, Status effect
fields.props: Piercing Skillshot, Channeled cast (stationary), Debuff Stasis, Stun
fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. Enemies inside the snowball are put in hostile Stasis. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, the targets are removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles), have no collision, cannot regenerate Health, Mana, Energy or Shields, cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed and some delayed heals applied beforehand are prevented.

abilities.name: Ice Wall
abilities.description: After a 0.75 second delay, create an impassable wall that traps enemy Heroes hit for 2.5 seconds. When the wall expires, trapped Heroes are Slowed by 75% decaying over 3 seconds.

fields.type: Crowd control, Status effect / Pathing blocker
fields.props: Area of Effect, Slow, Time Stop
fields.notes: 1) Area consists of 7 overlapping circular pathing blocker units with 1.5 radius. The first point of vector targeting determines the initial point and the second the direction. Blocker units are spawned at 0.125 second intervals, immediately affecting the units in their respective areas. Regardless, they will all expire at the same moment, as the duration of Ice Wall will not start counting until the wall has been fully formed.

talents.name: Heavy Pack
talents.description: Increases the duration of Snow Blind's Slow by 1.5 seconds. Each time Blizzard damages an enemy Hero, reduce the cooldown of Snow Blind by 0.5 seconds and gain 3 Mana.
_raw_fields: Increases the duration of Snow Blind's Slow by 1.5 seconds. Each time Blizzard damages an enemy Hero, reduce the cooldown of Snow Blind by 0.5 seconds and gain 3 Mana.

talents.name: Ice Storm
talents.description: Every 3rd hit of Blizzard against enemy Heroes deals an additional 42 damage. Blizzard's final stun damage is increased by 150% against all enemies.

fields.notes: Periodic bonus damage is dealt in a separate instance on the same tick in addition to the periodic damage. This damage instance does not interact with other talents affecting Blizzard. Stun damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Blizzard 's damage.

_raw_fields: Every 3rd hit of Blizzard against enemy Heroes deals an additional 42 damage. Blizzard's final stun damage is increased by 150% against all enemies.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Mei's Basic Attack damage.

fields.type: Defensive damage modifier, Healing modifier, Offensive damage modifier

talents.name: Cascade
talents.description: While traveling, Avalanche constantly launches a volley of untalented Snow Blind snowballs ahead of itself. Passive Reduce the cooldown of Avalanche by 30 seconds.

fields.notes: Launches a total of 22 snowballs: Immediately after release fires 5 snowballs over 0.375 seconds toward randomly selected 5 out of 7 possible predetermined locations ([x,y] = [0,10], [±2.75, 11], [±2.875, 12], [±2.75, 13]). It then continues to launch snowballs to 7 predetermined locations 12.5 units ahead (x = 0, ±2.75, ±3.75, ±4.25) in randomized order, one every 0.125 seconds. Upon reaching the end location, 5 more snowballs are released toward 8 possible locations within ~3.5 radius over 0.3125 seconds.
